newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg says no comment on Boliden.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg says no comment on Boliden.

text.p: Swedish miner Trelleborg declined to confirm or deny a newspaper report on Thursday that said it was planning to spin off its mining and metals unit Boliden, listing it on the Stockholm bourse.
Company spokesman Leif Oberg said Trelleborg had no comment on the report in business daily Dagens Industri.
"We have no comment on market rumours ... This has not come from the company management, I can promise you," Oberg told Reuters.
Trelleborg shares jumped seven percent in early trade Thursday on the report, rising seven crowns to 104 crowns.
